description: Microcosm-derived domestic electricity and gas consumption and meter counts by July 2024 constituency, Great Britain: each authority's DESNZ sub-national total split over its constituencies by DESNZ's own LSOA and data zone figures for the same year, through the committed atomic supports (microcosm#1095). Not Chronicle facts.

inputs.desnz_small_area: DESNZ LSOA and data zone domestic electricity and gas consumption, 2010 to 2024, OGL v3.0
inputs.desnz_subnational: DESNZ sub-national electricity and gas consumption statistics, Great Britain, 2005 to 2024, OGL v3.0
inputs.nrs_lookups: NRS output area (2022) lookups to data zones, council areas and 2024 constituencies, and the Census 2022 index households, OGL v3.0
inputs.ons_lookups: ONS output area (2021) lookups to LSOAs, local authorities and July 2024 constituencies, and Census 2021 TS041 households, OGL v3.0

parameters.scope: Great Britain: DESNZ publishes no small areas for Northern Ireland, which the family leaves out.
parameters.split_rule: Each output area's key is its LSOA's (data zone's) published value times the output area's share of the LSOA's census households; each authority's published total is shared among its constituency pieces in proportion to their keys, so every authority keeps its total and DESNZ's unallocated meters follow the split. A small area DESNZ publishes no row for carries no key.

period_coverage.notes: Domestic non-half-hourly electricity meters cover February through January.
